run_aro_evals: run ARO evaluation on a CLIP model across VG-Relation, VG-Attribution, COCO, and Flickr30k datasets
run_aro_on_lora: run ARO evaluation on a CLIP model loaded with merged LoRA weights from a given path
run_main: run ARO evaluation on the default openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 model by executing the script directly
review_run_aro_evals: review the run_aro_evals function to understand how it scores CLIP models on spatial relation benchmarks
review_run_aro_on_lora: review the run_aro_on_lora function to understand how it loads and merges LoRA weights before evaluation
